fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami city commissioners and policing, local and county political races and election preparations (including registration and poll tax), and civic conditions. Coverage criticizes streetcar service (including Miami Beach Railway/Florida Power & Light), discusses municipal purchasing of foreign vs. domestic construction materials, calls for comfort stations near Bayshore Park for an upcoming Shriner convention, and notes boating fuel-supply arrangements on Biscayne Bay. Additional pieces touch on public health enforcement against unsanitary home baking, local journalism, beauty contests, and tourism/nightlife items and advertisements in Greater Miami and Miami Beach.
